title: Hospice Room and Board Share, Patient Pay Collection and Reserved Bed Days — Medical Assistance Tier Settings
content:
For Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, four tier settings govern who collects patient pay, how it is credited when the resident has elected hospice, and whether reserved bed days change it.

| Tier | Hospice room-and-board share of the nursing facility Medicaid rate | Patient pay credited against the hospice's room-and-board payment | Patient pay unchanged for a month with Medicaid reserved bed days | Patient pay collected by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Standard Patient Pay | 0 percent | no | yes | the nursing facility |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Community Spouse Allowance | 0 percent | no | yes | the nursing facility |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Dependent Family Allowance | 0 percent | no | yes | the nursing facility |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, VA Reduced Pension | 0 percent | no | yes | the nursing facility |
| Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Care, Home Maintenance Allowance | 0 percent | no | yes | the nursing facility |
| Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board | 95 percent | yes | yes | the nursing facility |

**Hospice room-and-board share.** This is the share of the nursing facility Medicaid daily rate that the state pays the hospice for room and board. The federal minimum is 95 percent, and the Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board tier is set at 95 percent; the other five tiers carry no hospice share (0 percent).

**Hospice credit.** On the Medical Assistance Hospice Room and Board tier, patient pay collected for the resident is credited against the hospice's room-and-board payment rather than against the Medicaid per diem. On the other five tiers no such credit applies.

**Reserved bed days.** On every tier, patient pay is unchanged for a month in which the resident has Medicaid reserved bed days.

**Collection.** On every tier, the resident's patient pay is collected by the nursing facility.

*Illustration (hypothetical figures):* where 13 days were priced at a 95 percent share of a nursing facility Medicaid daily rate of 251.83 dollars, the share for those days would be 3,110.10 dollars — 13 multiplied by 251.83, multiplied by 95, divided by 100, with that total rounded half up to the cent (no per-day figure is rounded). The figures illustrate the percentage only and are not a rate of any center.
